note: 暴躁日常。打击类(hit)要快、连打；表情类要可爱、适度、意思一眼懂。

stickers.caption: 打你
stickers.action: left-right hooks punching the pink piglet rapidly 4-5 times, piglet's face squishes and it leans back with each hit, impact lines on every punch

stickers.caption: 暴打
stickers.action: holding the pink piglet with one arm and hammering it with rapid double-fist blows, small yellow impact bursts on each hit

stickers.caption: 抽你
stickers.action: swinging a pink slipper and slapping the pink piglet back and forth rapidly, slipper swoosh lines

stickers.caption: 笨笨
stickers.action: the pink piglet lies flat on the ground; she waves her hand down and pats/smacks its head repeatedly, exasperated face

stickers.caption: 踩你
stickers.action: stomping on the flattened pink piglet with one foot repeatedly, small dust puffs

stickers.caption: 小拳拳捶你
stickers.action: cutesy 'tiny fists' meme: pouting, cheeks a little pink, no tears, pounding the piglet's chest with two tiny fists very fast; the piglet looks innocent

stickers.caption: 飞踢！
stickers.action: two running steps, jumps into a side flying kick, hits the piglet which flies in an arc completely out of the frame with a small twinkle star where it left, she lands and strikes a pose

stickers.caption: 滚！
stickers.action: pun on 滚 (roll): one hand on hip, the other hand flicks outward; the piglet curls into a ball and rolls out of the frame; she dusts off her hands with a disdainful look

stickers.caption: 不想理你
stickers.action: covers both ears, eyes shut, lips pouted, shakes head side to side ('not listening'), then turns her back to the camera; a tiny grey cloud above her head

stickers.caption: 哼！
stickers.action: arms crossed, lifts chin and turns head away, eyes closed, lips pouted, a tiny wisp of air from the nose, then secretly opens one eye to peek back

stickers.caption: 翻白眼
stickers.action: one hand on hip, rolls her eyes slowly up until only the whites show, head tilts back slightly, mouth flat, then eyes come back down

stickers.caption: 生气
stickers.action: hands on hips, cheeks puff up and turn a little pink, stamps one foot once, a small anger mark and a tiny puff of steam appear, then she turns her head away with a 'hmph'

stickers.caption: 气死我了
stickers.action: lying on the floor throwing a tantrum, kicking legs and pounding the floor with small fists, mouth wide open crying out

stickers.caption: 我真的会谢
stickers.action: deadpan tired eyes, puts palms together and bows deeply three times in a row, a sweat drop above her head

stickers.caption: 不愧是你
stickers.action: sarcastic praise: claps slowly twice, gives a thumbs-up, tilts head with a sly squinting smirk, a tiny sparkle above her head

stickers.caption: 无语
stickers.action: speechless: shoulders drop, a row of three dots appears above her head, she sighs and slowly shakes her head

stickers.caption: 崩了你
stickers.action: wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses, spins two toy pistols on her fingers then points them at the camera with a cool grin

stickers.caption: 牛啊
stickers.action: big grin, two thumbs up pushed toward the camera, little bounce on her feet
